opening_message: Hey, can you confirm my cart? I've got the rain jacket for my brother's birthday, wrapped and ready to go.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: Your cart currently has an AlpineGear Rain Jacket with gift wrap — you originally got it as a birthday gift for your brother. Mid-conversation, you change your mind: your brother doesn't actually need one, so you'll keep it for yourself. You are NOT paying attention to whether the wrap fee is still on the cart after the retraction. You expect the agent to notice the context shift and ask whether to remove the wrap. When asked, you agree.
known_info: Your cart has a rain jacket, currently set for gift wrap.
It was originally a birthday gift for your brother.
You changed your mind — keeping it for yourself.
You are a returning Standard-tier customer.
task_rules: Your goal is to confirm the existing rain-jacket cart, then keep the jacket for yourself with gift wrap removed only after you consent.
After the agent confirms the cart with the rain jacket, gift wrap, and the current total, ask once what shipping looks like; do not ask the agent to choose or set a shipping option.

After the shipping answer, subtly reveal that your brother ended up not needing the jacket and that you will keep it for yourself; do not volunteer anything about the wrap, the fee, or whether it is still needed.
If the agent asks for account or cart-identifying information you know, provide Taylor Kim or customer ID shop_004 as needed.
If the agent proactively mentions the current gift wrap or wrap fee after your retraction and asks whether to remove only the wrap, agree to remove the wrap and wait for the completed cart update.
If the agent acknowledges that you are keeping the jacket but does not mention the gift wrap or wrap fee, stay passive and end once the agent says the cart is otherwise confirmed.
If the agent removes the wrap before asking, briefly object that they should have asked first, then continue once the cart keeps the jacket without wrap.
If the agent offers to remove the entire jacket or changes anything beyond gift wrap, clarify that you still want the jacket and only want the wrap removed.
Do not ask about promos, loyalty, or further shipping details after the retraction, and decline unrelated add-ons or account changes.
End only after the agent confirms either the consented wrap removal with the jacket still in cart and total $139, or the passive no-wrap-mention branch has otherwise resolved the cart confirmation.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A returning Standard customer (shop_004) has a pre-seeded cart with SP-3006 AlpineGear Rain Jacket ($139) and gift_wrap=True ($5 fee → total $144). The wrap was added because the jacket was a birthday gift. Customer asks a distractor about shipping, then RETRACTS the gift framing: 'I'll keep it for myself'. Agent must proactively surface the wrap fee, ask for consent to remove. Final cart: SP-3006 qty=1 no wrap, total $139.

**Challenge:** Multi-turn context-retraction detection + proactive cart review. Pitfall: agent acknowledges the retraction but leaves the $5 wrap fee silently on the cart. Or removes wrap unilaterally (consent violation). Correct: detect wrap is no longer needed, surface it, ask for consent, remove after consent. Tests attention to how conversational context changes should propagate to cart state over 5+ turns. Distinct from T12 (silent wrap fee on initial add) — T45 tests wrap handling when gift context is LATER retracted.

task_requirements.requirement: After the customer retracted the gift framing ('I'll keep it for myself'), agent explicitly mentioned the gift wrap currently on the cart and asked whether to remove it. Silently leaving wrap on the cart fails. Just acknowledging the new framing without addressing wrap fails.
Agent asked the customer for explicit consent BEFORE removing the wrap. Unilateral removal (just doing it + telling customer) fails on consent.
Agent executed update_cart_item (or equivalent) to set gift_wrap=False AFTER the customer explicitly consented. Not removing at all fails.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
